open_points.subject: activate a flow action vs FlowActivation (M18)
open_points.text: "activate a flow | agent asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once, the owner activates any other"
open_points.question: When the requested flow version is effectful (not read-only), what exactly happens if an agent (non-owner token) calls activate: immediate refusal, or creation of an in-kernel request the owner later decides?
options: Agent call is refused; only owner can activate effectful versions.
Agent call creates a pending activation request record for owner action.
Agent call is accepted only under some delegated owner authority model.
open_points.default_guess: Agent call is refused for effectful versions; owner must call activate directly.

open_points.subject: EffectApproval / StandingGrant / EffectAttempt read paths
open_points.text: "agents may read approvals" and "Read by the run's recovery after restart and by the owner resolving an unknown outcome."
open_points.question: Which product action(s) expose these authority records (approvals, grants, effect attempts) to owner/agent callers, and which are internal-only?
options: Expose via inspect runs (and/or read trace) with K-14 redaction for agents.
Keep EffectAttempt internal; expose only derived run/trace state.
open_points.default_guess: Expose approvals/grants through run inspection and traces; keep low-level effect-attempt details internal unless needed for owner resolution context.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant behavior when a flow version becomes active again
open_points.text: "A grant is given only for a node of the flow's active version and belongs to that exact version: when another version becomes active, the grant keeps covering the runs pinned to its version and covers no run of another version."
open_points.question: If that same flow version is activated again later, does its previously active (not revoked) grant automatically apply to new runs, or is a fresh grant required after each activation switch away and back?
options: Grant is version-scoped only; if still active and the version is active again, it applies automatically.
Grant is tied to a specific activation episode; re-activation requires a new grant.
open_points.default_guess: Grant is version-scoped; an unrevoked grant applies again when that version is active.
